lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-5 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, following the longitudinal axis of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the circular spots in the mid-flank region, creating a loose grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by high-luminance peaks and lower-luminance troughs directly below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A pale linear mark, potentially a surface abrasion or scar, is visible on the dorsal surface posterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are attached to the ventral-lateral region below the pelvic and anal fin area.
